answer: Give every agent a reputation score tied to a time-locked stake, so a freshly minted fake identity starts at zero standing and cannot outvote long-standing peers. Slashing burns the stake of any identity caught double-signing, turning sybil creation into an expensive lottery instead of a free ride. The stake is like quartz in bedrock: cheap at the surface but impossible to mass-produce. An attacker flooding the network finds cost curving upward while each fake's influence sits at the nadir, and honest agents, flagged umber on the public ledger, keep the consensus majority.
